text:
Maya (partnerships): FYI GCP Marketplace PO #GCP-19182 failed ingestion. Portal rejects for vendor_id mismatch + VAT country mismatch. Can someone triage?
marketplace-bot: PO GCP-19182 ingestion_status=FAILED; reason=vendor_id_mismatch; code=409; details=vat_country!=billing_country; link=https://gcp.marketplace/po/GCP-19182
Rafael (procurement): Noted. Looks like partner has two vendor IDs (EU vs US). Billing shows US EIN but VAT country = DE on invoice PDFs.
Emma (sales): Customer wants to be in the April launch cycle. They already signed SOW. If we wait for partner to re-map vendor id it could be 72+ hrs. Any fast path?
Priya (legal): Short checklist: 1) Do we have partner's W-9 or EU VAT registration? 2) Are they requesting incoterm or tax passthrough changes? If we accept mixed countries we might trigger reverse charge.
Maya (partnerships): Partner attached two docs: DE VAT cert (VAT-DE-44321) and US W-9 (W9-ACMEUS). They claim goods are digitally delivered, so VAT shouldn't apply, but marketplace requires country alignment for vendor id.
Sam (partnerops): We can request partner to submit vendor mapping correction. There's also an emergency manual accept process but it requires approvals from procurement + legal + finance. Typically takes ~6h if finance available.
Rafael (procurement): Suggest: open emergency ticket and ask finance for temporary manual accept. Meanwhile ask partner to start vendor re-mapping (we'll need proof of bank wiring country).
Emma (sales): I'll confirm with customer if they can accept a provisional invoice and net 30 billing outside marketplace while mapping completes. That preserves launch.
Priya (legal): I'm OK with manual accept if finance signs off and partner provides indemnity on tax exposure. I'll draft a one-page addendum they can sign today.
Maya (partnerships): Cool. Sam please kick the emergency flow and tag finance. Rafael pls prepare a concise procurement note. Emma pls get customer OK for provisional billing. I'll coordinate addendum signature.
Sam (partnerops): Creating emergency ticket now.

```
PO: GCP-19182
partner: AcmeCloud GmbH / AcmeCloud Inc
vendor_ids: ["VID-EU-9987", "VID-US-1100"]
billing_country: US
vat_country_on_invoice: DE
attached_docs: [VAT-DE-44321.pdf, W9-ACMEUS.pdf]
issue: vendor_id_mismatch + vat_country_mismatch
```

marketplace-bot: Ticket EMG-441 created; partner notified; expected finance response SLA=6h
Rafael (procurement): Drafting procurement note and will attach bank country evidence. ETA 1h.
Priya (legal): I'll have the addendum draft ready for review in 2h. If partner signs today we can approve manual accept.
Emma (sales): Customer said yes to provisional billing if it means launch stays on track. Sending confirmation now.
Maya (partnerships): Thanks all. I'll update the marketplace escalation spreadsheet and ping leadership if finance stalls. :thumbsup:
marketplace-bot: EMG-441 status=OPEN; last_update=1755556120
